# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: VIE campaign on actions — event hooks.
## COLDWAR | Approved Vietnam campaign extension. Generated by campaigns.py.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			VIE = { COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_daily_update = yes }
		}
	}
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { original_tag = VIE }
				COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_daily_update = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { original_tag = VIE }
				COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_daily_update = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
